events.title: Blackout Route Playtest Is Live — Invite Your Friends and Play Together!
events.summary: The Blackout Route Open Playtest is now live!Gather your friends, team up, and head out on raids together. Explore dangerous locations, search for valuable resources, use vehicles, return to your camp, and prepare for the next run. The game is still in active development, so you may encounter bugs, multiplayer issues, balance problems, and performance issues during the Playtest. events.title: Blackout Route: The Road Begins Here
events.summary: Hey, everyone!This is our very first news post on the Blackout Route Steam page, so it feels like the right time to properly introduce the game and share what’s coming next. We’re a small indie team at Blackout Inc., and we’ve been working on Blackout Route for quite a while.Blackout Route is a 2–4 player online PvE co-op survival action game.
